observations.detail: Photographed box remains sharp in a softly blurred room; selected Bream jacket is large and legible, with clear separation from the dark information card.4b identification, exact Spotify action and Mozart→Bream→Firebird neighbors are visible without overlap.

At390px the jacket fits with margins, top return control remains visible, front/back/disc controls and neighbor cards stay reachable, and the information panel flows vertically. No visible horizontal clipping or text collision.

Correct outer LP back fills the same jacket area, selected Back control is clear, and the sourced-back/pressing qualification is visible. Fine rear print is naturally small at this scale; this frame does not establish zoomed text readability.

Reviewed replacement settled frame: the actual family rear is square and fully visible, its title and original print are clear, and it sits beside a readable information card without overlap. The family-copy caption and search-only Spotify wording are accurate. Parent measured349.590×349.590 image bounds; the prior compressed frame was captured mid-flip, not a layout defect.

visualReview.judgment: The visible result is cohesive and polished: album artwork has enough emphasis, the original room context remains present, and controls/captions clearly distinguish reference art, the family copy and verified listening. No user-facing blocker is visible in the four frames. Static screenshots alone cannot establish animation smoothness, hit accuracy or full mobile interaction quality.
